## Theses and internships

Looking for a master's thesis or internship? Fill in the form below with your CV and we will get back to you.

For PhD and postdoc positions, please apply through our [Openings](news.html#openings) page. Thank you!

```{=html}
<!-- Netlify Forms: Netlify finds this form when the site is deployed, stores
     each application (with the CV) and emails it to the address set in the
     Netlify dashboard. It does not send anything from the local preview. -->
<div id="apply-thanks" class="apply-thanks" hidden>
  <strong>Thank you for your application!</strong> We have received it and will get back to you.
</div>

<form name="join-the-lab" method="POST" action="/takepart.html?applied=1"
      data-netlify="true" netlify-honeypot="bot-field"
      enctype="multipart/form-data" class="apply-form" id="apply-form">
  <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="join-the-lab">
  <input type="hidden" name="subject" data-remove-prefix value="New application to the DeMON Lab">
  <p class="apply-hidden"><label>Leave this empty: <input name="bot-field"></label></p>

  <div class="apply-grid">
    <label>Full name *
      <input type="text" name="name" required autocomplete="name">
    </label>
    <label>Email *
      <input type="email" name="email" required autocomplete="email">
    </label>
    <label>University / institution *
      <input type="text" name="university" required>
    </label>
    <label>Major / field of study *
      <input type="text" name="major" required placeholder="e.g. Bioinformatics, Statistics">
    </label>
    <label>Current degree level *
      <select name="degree" required>
        <option value="">Choose…</option>
        <option>Bachelor student</option>
        <option>Master student</option>
        <option>PhD student</option>
        <option>PhD graduate</option>
        <option>Other</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>What would you like to apply for? *
      <select name="position" required>
        <option value="">Choose…</option>
        <option>Bachelor project / thesis</option>
        <option>Master project / thesis</option>
        <option>Internship</option>
        <option>Research assistant</option>
        <option>Visiting researcher</option>
        <option>Other</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Preferred start date
      <input type="month" name="start">
    </label>
    <label>Expected duration
      <select name="duration">
        <option value="">Choose…</option>
        <option>Less than 3 months</option>
        <option>3–6 months</option>
        <option>6–12 months</option>
        <option>More than 12 months</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <fieldset class="apply-interests">
    <legend>Research interests</legend>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="interests" value="PET"> PET</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="interests" value="fMRI"> fMRI</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="interests" value="Omics"> Omics</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="interests" value="AI / machine learning"> AI / machine learning</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="interests" value="Other"> Other</label>
  </fieldset>

  <label>Programming skills
    <input type="text" name="skills" placeholder="e.g. Python, R, MATLAB">
  </label>
  <label>Why do you want to join the DeMON Lab? *
    <textarea name="motivation" rows="6" required maxlength="2000"
              placeholder="A few sentences about your background, interests and what you would like to work on"></textarea>
  </label>
  <label>LinkedIn, Google Scholar or website
    <input type="url" name="profile" placeholder="https://">
  </label>
  <label>CV (PDF or Word, max 8 MB) *
    <input type="file" name="cv" accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx" required>
  </label>
  <label class="apply-consent">
    <input type="checkbox" name="consent" value="yes" required>
    I agree that the DeMON Lab stores the information and CV I send, only to review my application and contact me. *
  </label>

  <button type="submit" class="apply-submit">Submit application</button>
</form>

<script>
// Netlify returns visitors to this page with ?applied=1 after a successful
// submission: show the thank-you message instead of the form.
if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("applied") === "1") {
  document.getElementById("apply-form").hidden = true;
  document.getElementById("apply-thanks").hidden = false;
}

// CVs larger than Netlify's 8 MB limit are refused before sending.
document.getElementById("apply-form").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
  var file = this.querySelector('input[name="cv"]').files[0];
  if (file && file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert("Your CV is larger than 8 MB. Please upload a smaller file.");
  }
});
</script>
```
